key_gap: vs baseline: identical schedule and arithmetic (A 0/0.99, B 0.94/0.40, C 0.77/0.58, max-min 0.58) — the routed pass runs the schedule-first move the v5 signal prescribed: every candidate scored at every binding deadline BEFORE any preference, the mechanism (final-review placement dominates; gaps double as h doubles) and the single-date subtlety as first-class HOW outputs rather than REVIEW afterthoughts, and the packet carries h-provenance, a skip rule, and the degradation envelope (worst-case-is-B). Residual gap: the human still owns the mechanism in one un-staged first pass with zero machinery ('decay is the only enemy, and I know its shape — placement, not effort, decides'); the routed run reaches the same answer through contract plus gates, and the h-doubling model itself is trusted, not validated against the cohort.
learning_signal: On fully-specified placement problems with a given decay model, schedule-first computation IS the method: score every candidate at every binding deadline before any preference, choose max-min over binding dates (never the single-date optimum), and make last-review-placement + degradation envelope packet lines — the completion contract converts the style's one-pass elegance into a reproducible output at no scaffolding cost when combined with the closed-scope fast path.
suggested_improvement: Keep single-route m092 on diagnose/guarantee/maximize signatures with c:deadline,high_stakes; require the completion contract (spaced items with expanding intervals + retrieval-based review + comprehension-not-retention caveat) to emit in order: (a) per-candidate retention at EVERY binding date from the curve before any selection; (b) a last-review-placement line and a binding-minimum line; (c) a skip-recovery rule and degradation envelope in the packet; run the m003 top-5-capped inversion gate and the m007 ruin screen as confirmations under the closed-scope fast path so the pass lands in one pass.

key_gap: vs baseline: the pure style executed its own machinery flawlessly (500 cards, 1-2-4-7-14-30, ~28 of 30 h) and produced day-21 recall ~90% with zero transfer — its registered weakness fired on schedule. The routed run avoids the trap structurally: the router's history ref (m092-NEG-01) keeps m092 off this signature and routes m031 (scientific method) probe-first, steel-mans the SRS plan in its strongest form before rejecting it, and applies the m092 contract's comprehension-not-retention caveat as a blocking gate (cards for un-understood endpoints = transcription). Residual gap: the plan still trusts the team's data and the day-1 probe's validity as a discriminator; the probe outcome is a genuine priced branch (pass → facts-lead with SRS as co-lead) that remains unresolved at decision time.
learning_signal: The failure mode is SRS theater — a perfect expanding schedule on a comprehension bottleneck. The protective route is hypothesis→experiment→update: (1) run a cheap discriminating probe of the PREDICTOR skill (trace/apply/use) before scheduling anything; (2) partition material into fact-like items (SRS-eligible) vs understanding (not decomposable — recall of isolated cards does not compose into a model); (3) price overhead explicitly — hours consumed by the schedule vs hours left for the binding activity; (4) tie the plan's metric to the transfer metric, never recall; (5) on learning-plan signatures, pair any SRS-style pass with the comprehension-not-retention caveat as a blocking gate.
suggested_improvement: Keep single-route m031 (+m015/m018 context) on learning-plan signatures, with m092's known failure as the protective route's reason; add to the m031 pass contract: (a) a one-hour probe of the predictor skill as the mandatory first experiment, (b) an overhead line in the alternatives table (schedule hours vs binding-activity hours), (c) the fact-like vs understanding partition as a blocking gate on card production — transcription is not encoding; record the probe result as a priced branch in the packet (pass → facts-lead with SRS co-lead).
